harnessGeneration.note: Controls the fields and functions emitted for a generated worker harness.

memory.note: Controls worker input, context additions, completion, and turn records.

functions.note: Memory functions grouped by execution seat.

self.note: Host-owned functions returning or mutating runtime objects.

after_turn.note: Updates host memory after a turn.

participant.note: Pure-data functions called through Memory participant seats.

intake.note: May reshape inbound text or end before a model call.

system_addendum.note: May add text after the system prefix.

archive.note: May stamp data on the completed turn record.

planning.note: Controls guidance and planning around model calls.

reasoningEffort.note: Would override reasoning effort for this dispatch.

maxToolIterations.note: Would cap tool iterations for this dispatch.

functions.note: Planning functions grouped by execution seat.

self.note: Host-owned functions returning runtime planning objects.

participant.note: Pure-data functions called through Planning participant seats.

advise.note: May add guidance around a model call.

capability.note: Controls tool definitions offered to the worker.

tools.note: Narrows tool names for this dispatch.

functions.note: Capability functions grouped by execution seat.

self.note: Host-owned functions returning runtime capability objects.

participant.note: Pure-data functions called through Capability participant seats.

select_tools.note: May reshape the full tool-schema array.

action.note: Controls model-call checks and generated judgements.

checks.note: Adds declarative checks before worker tool calls.

checksImpl.note: Would select an installed check implementation.

functions.note: Action functions grouped by execution seat.

self.note: Host-owned functions performing the model decision.

participant.note: Pure-data functions called through Action participant seats.

judge.note: Returns refusal sentences before one tool call.

review.note: May accept, resample, or end a model step.

salvage.note: May supply a missing final reply.
